decisions.reason: Having survived the initial post-launch pruning and received its own website page, this cheese appears integrated into the firm's core range, so management influenced by prior investment and public commitment would be inclined to continue it unless results clearly deteriorate.

Although a spicy cheese is somewhat more niche and therefore somewhat more vulnerable, the firm's visible continued support after launch makes escalation of commitment likely to favor retaining it for at least another year.

This product was explicitly highlighted at launch and then maintained with its own page, suggesting a relatively strong strategic and reputational commitment that would make management reluctant to withdraw it quickly.
